impact:
ISS-012 fixed the half it was filed for — a swap inside a program day is now a session substitution that carries the slot's targets, so a swapped program day is finishable again. It deliberately left the other half, which ISS-012's own report named: an exercise that fills no program slot still cannot read as done, and nothing on the screen says the workout is over.

WHERE THE DEFECT IS
- apps/web/src/lib/session.ts:3 — `isExerciseDone = e.fromProgram && e.loggedSets.length >= e.targetSets`. The first conjunct is false for every ad-hoc exercise, so it is never done whatever is logged.
- apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:425 — `pipCount = Math.max(active.targetSets, active.loggedSets.length + 1)`, so an ad-hoc exercise always shows exactly one more empty pip. In a freeform session that is every exercise in it.
- apps/api/src/routes/sessions.ts:211 — `adhocExercises` sets `targetSets: loggedSets.length`, i.e. there is no target to reach, only a count of what happened.

WHERE THE SYMPTOM IS TRIGGERED FROM
`FreeformSessionScreen` (apps/web/src/screens/session/SessionScreen.tsx:87-89) and the "＋ Add an exercise" panel on a program day.

WHAT IS DELIBERATE
CLAUDE.md records that `isExerciseDone` is false for ad-hoc exercises on purpose: it keeps a freeform session focused on what was just added rather than declaring itself finished after one set. That rule is defensible; what it does not provide is any way for the user to say a ride is over. So this is a design change, not a bug fix, and it needs a decision.

DIRECTIONS (from ISS-012's report, minus the part already done)
1. An editable set count on an ad-hoc exercise — the user's own suggestion ("allows me to edit set count"). Needs a per-session target for an exercise that no program slot plans.
2. A "Finish workout" action on the session screen. The only terminal control today is the "Review session" link (SessionScreen.tsx:920-924). Worth having regardless of 1.
These are not exclusive.

VERIFIED vs SUSPECTED
Verified by reading at HEAD after the ISS-012 fix; line numbers checked at time of writing. Not reproduced at runtime.
title: A freeform session can never read as finished: an ad-hoc exercise has no set target and there is no finish action
